translator_notes: Unchecked machine translation. I treated this as an urban tavern folk song; I could not confirm it has no known author. 'Пеачки' as singing girls is my reading.

lines.en: The taverns, mother dear, have ruined me,
those slender singing girls have made me sick.
Taverns, taverns, what have you done to me,
you taverns have taken my life from me.

lines.cyr: Цел ноќ седам в' меана, саноќ си пијам,
lines.lat: Cel noḱ sedam v' meana, sanoḱ si pijam,
lines.en: All night I sit in the tavern, all night I drink,

lines.cyr: песна, свирка сал слушам и се веселам.
lines.lat: pesna, svirka sal slušam i se veselam.
lines.en: I only listen to song and playing and make merry.
Taverns, taverns, what have you done to me,
you taverns have taken my life from me.
My sweetheart left me, forgot me,

lines.cyr: сè за таа ракија, што ми направи.
lines.lat: sè za taa rakija, što mi napravi.
lines.en: all because of that brandy, what it did to me.
Taverns, taverns, what have you done to me,
you taverns have taken my life from me.
